in_marathi.name: Eshwaria
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshwaria हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eshwaria is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Eshwar, which means God. The female form of this name signifies the divine feminine energy of the universe, often associated with creation, sustenance, and destruction.
